messages:
erin: quick check — i've got two dependent PRs that need to land in the same merge window today at 16:00 PT. SDK PR is ready but waits on the API compatibility change. links below

erin: SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4783 (needs api client bump)
erin: API: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/9021 (adds optional header and response shape tweak)

ben: noted. what's blocking the API PR from getting an approval?

maya: i left a couple comments on the API shape change — mostly nit + one question about the nullable field. will re-review once that's addressed.

frank: CI flaky on api/integration-test::response-schema on node 18 — looks unrelated but green on re-run? anyone seen this?

ci-bot: re-run triggered by erin. build #9021.5 — all tests started.

erin: thanks maya — i can take the schema tweak now. i want to avoid a long rework in SDK if we change after merge.

maya: pushed a small patch to api PR to make the field optional with explanatory comment. PTAL.

ben: i'll take the sdk PR diff while tests run. if api PR merges first i can update the client bump in sdk quickly.

tim: FYI console team - the console has a runtime feature flag that reads the header. the change should be backwards compatible but tagging you in case you want to smoke test after canary. @alice?

alice: i can do a quick canary run after merge. schedule ok for 17:00 PT?

erin: merge plan proposal: wait for maya approval, re-run CI one more time on API, merge API -> bump client in SDK -> merge SDK into main in the 16:00 window. if flake persists, fallback to merging during 18:00 window with canary at 19:00. sound good?

maya: approve from me once tests green. :+1:

ci-bot: build #9021.5 — all tests passed.

ben: got the green, updating sdk client dependency in a patch branch now. will open PR for the bump in ~10m.

erin: thanks all. @ben please ping here when the SDK bump PR is up so i can gate the merge slot.

ben: SDK bump PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4784 — small lockfile update + changelog. requesting review from @erin and @frank.

frank: quick look now. if lgtm i'll approve and we can merge in the 16:00 slot.

frank: lgtm, approving.

erin: merged API PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/9021) at 16:02 PT. bumped object schema and added comment.

ben: merged SDK bump (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4784) at 16:18 PT. all green.

alice: starting console canary against staging now. will report if anything odd in header handling.

alice: canary looks clean — no console errors and feature flag behaves.

erin: sweet. leaving a note for release train: these two PRs paired; no rollback needed. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :tada:

maya: nice one.

ben: thanks team.

ci-bot: deploy log: staging canary OK.

erin: filing a short post-note in the release tracker linking the PRs and the canary results.

frank: one follow-up action: i'll add a tiny test to cover the nullable header branch in integration suite tomorrow morning.

erin: added to eng-platform backlog as a follow-up.

alice: closing loop from console side. all good.

tim: thanks — reassigning related tickets to verify prod rollout during next maintenance window.
